summary: Centerspace filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting a routine reduction in its revolving credit facility capacity. The company elected to terminate a previously exercised accordion option, reducing aggregate borrowing capacity from $400 million to $250 million, effective August 28, 2026. No price, stake, or premium terms are involved. This is a standard credit facility administration matter with no strategic or capital markets implications, no board recommendation, and no special-situation features. The filing is purely operational disclosure with nothing to watch from an event-driven or risk-arbitrage perspective.
